piece.headline: RAVIN TAKES OVER AT THE TOP, NIKHIL HANDS IT OVER
piece.standfirst: Ravin wins the week and takes top spot, 11 clear. Marcel has a nightmare, and 23 managers all trusted the same armband.
piece.big_picture: Ravin takes top spot from Nikhil and sits 11 points clear. Nikhil had a quiet week at the wrong moment. That gap is a real cushion, but it's only week 5 and Rohan is lurking in third.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Amit, Aashiv and Marcel all left their best players on the bench. Each had 20 points sitting there. 3 managers, one very expensive mistake.
piece.one_to_watch: Marcel and Ravi Bhojwani are separated by 1 point at the Tin Pot line. One decent week could flip it, and one bad week could drag either of them down.

winners.name: Ravin
winners.verdict: Top score, top spot. The armband delivered and the chasing pack now have a name to fear.

winners.name: Ravi Bhojwani
winners.verdict: Climbed clear of the Tin Pot spots. 12 points on the bench stopped it being a party.

losers.name: Marcel
losers.verdict: Went alone on Fernandes and got 4 for the armband. Lonely call, lonely week. Bounce back is on the cards.

losers.name: Aashiv
losers.verdict: The wrong 11 started, and 20 points watched from the bench. Self-inflicted, and the Gold spots line is only 3 away.

ratings.l: Took the lead and the armband paid. Deserved, and the others should worry.
